{{quote|Nothing fancy, just a way to get around. Alas, disposable.|Item description}}
Grants the ability to teleport once while not consuming the cooldown of [[Teleportstone]]. 

Received 3 from [[Master Alaric]] after completing quest line that requires [[Blood]] or [[Bucket of blood]]. It can also be obtained after giving [[Master Alaric]] 1 [[Bucket of blood]] for 1 {{PAGENAME}} after completing the vampire quest line
